_task_class_guidance.binary: Pass/fail tasks. Must be done correctly regardless of QT. Single production rate. Examples: dust surface, apply primer, remove tape.
_task_class_guidance.qt_conditional: Tasks that only appear in certain quality tiers. Examples: inspection rounds (QT4/QT5 only), between-coat sanding (QT4/QT5).
_task_class_guidance.qt_scaled: Tasks in all tiers but production rate varies. Higher QT = slower pace, more scrutiny. Examples: cut-in, rolling finish coats.
